csv_project_name: Design for Guthrie-Edmond Regional Airport New Taxilane
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Guthrie-Edmond Regional Airport New Taxilane. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to construct a new taxilane in support of the new terminal building and foster growth on the southwest portion of the airport. The current terminal building will soon be replaced and to open up development areas to the southwest of the airport. This project is intended to foster growth and expand into an industrial park area to foster economic development for the community and region. This project may be dependent on FAA ATP funding, and is shown with a 90/10 FAA grant partnered with a 95/5 ODAA grant.
